title: 2026 Bellwether Watch — Key Republican-Held / GOP-Target House Seats
notes: Seven U.S. House races Ryan Brauns is tracking as bellwethers for control of the chambers of Congress. Results are unofficial election-night returns pulled from each state's official reporting site.

races.label: Florida 25th
races.region: Boca Raton – Fort Lauderdale – Miami Beach (new 2026 map)
races.seat_status: Held by Democrat Jared Moskowitz; district redrawn in 2026 to lean Republican
races.baseline: Trump won the new district in 2024 (est. +5 to +9)
races.watch_for: A GOP pickup here validates Florida's mid-decade redistricting strategy.

races.label: Michigan 4th
races.region: Southwest Michigan lakeshore — Holland, Kalamazoo, Battle Creek
races.baseline: Huizenga 55.0% – Swartz 43.4% (2024)
races.watch_for: A single-digit Huizenga win or loss signals a strong Democratic night in the Midwest.

races.label: Virginia 1st
races.region: Richmond suburbs, Northern Neck, Middle Peninsula, Williamsburg
races.baseline: Wittman 56.3% – Mehta 43.5% (2024); Trump 51.6% in district
races.watch_for: First East Coast bellwether to report; DCCC Red-to-Blue target.

races.label: Virginia 2nd
races.region: Hampton Roads — Virginia Beach, Chesapeake, Suffolk, Eastern Shore
races.seat_status: Held by Republican Jen Kiggans (since 2023); flipped R→D→R since 2016
races.baseline: Cook PVI EVEN; Kiggans ~51–47 (2024); Harris lost district by <1 pt; Spanberger 53% (2025)
races.watch_for: The purest 50/50 seat on the board and the first to report — direction of the night, not its size.

races.label: North Carolina 11th
races.region: Western North Carolina — Asheville, Hendersonville, the mountain counties
races.seat_status: Open seat — Rep. Chuck Edwards (R) withdrew Aug. 2026 after a House Ethics report; GOP substituted state Rep. Jennifer Balkcom
races.baseline: Trump +~10 (2024); Edwards won 2024 by ~14; no Democrat has held the seat since 2012 (Shuler)
races.watch_for: Helene-recovery anger plus a scandal-driven candidate swap — a Democratic win here means the wave reached deep-red Appalachia.

races.label: Texas 35th
races.region: San Antonio Southside out to New Braunfels & Floresville (new 2025 map)
races.seat_status: Open seat — redrawn as a GOP pickup opportunity; Rep. Greg Casar (D) moved to TX-37
races.rating: Likely R (Inside Elections: Dems could win only in a blue wave)
races.baseline: Newly drawn; GOP-favored
races.watch_for: The purest test of whether the Texas redistricting gamble pays off.

races.label: Texas 1st
races.region: East Texas — Tyler, Longview, Nacogdoches, Texarkana
races.baseline: Moran unopposed in 2024; Trump +26.5 in district
races.watch_for: Margin check only — if Moran's margin compresses sharply, rural GOP turnout is soft statewide.

races.label: Texas 15th
races.region: Rio Grande Valley north into rural Central Texas (new 2025 map)
races.seat_status: Held by Republican Monica De La Cruz (since 2023)
races.rating: Lean R / Likely R — public polling has shown Pulido competitive
races.baseline: Trump +18 in new district (2024); De La Cruz won old district by 14
races.watch_for: Hispanic-voter realignment test; Democrats' best Texas pickup shot.

races.label: Montana 1st
races.region: Western Montana — Missoula, Bozeman, Kalispell, Butte
races.seat_status: Open seat — Rep. Ryan Zinke (R) retired March 2026
races.baseline: Zinke won 2022 and 2024 over Monica Tranel
races.watch_for: Last to close; an open-seat test of GOP strength in a growth-state district.

races.label: Maine — U.S. Senate
races.region: Statewide (ranked-choice; first-round totals on election night)
races.seat_status: Held by Republican Susan Collins (since 1997) — the only GOP senator up in a Harris state
races.baseline: Collins 51–42 (2020) while Biden carried Maine by 9; Harris +7 (2024)
races.watch_for: The single most important Senate seat for control. If Collins falls, Democrats' path to a majority is open. RCV: if no one clears 50%, the final tally comes days later.

races.label: Michigan — U.S. Senate
races.region: Statewide (open seat)
races.baseline: Trump +1.4 (2024); Slotkin (D) beat Rogers by 0.3 in 2024
races.watch_for: Rogers' second try; a Democratic hold is required for any Senate path.

races.label: Minnesota — U.S. Senate
races.region: Statewide (open seat)
races.baseline: Harris +4 (2024); no Republican statewide win since 2006
races.watch_for: A Republican upset here would signal a red night; margin tells you about the Upper Midwest.

races.label: Kansas — U.S. Senate
races.region: Statewide
races.baseline: Marshall 53–42 (2020); Trump +16 (2024); no Democrat since 1932
races.watch_for: Pastor Adam Hamilton has made a 90-year GOP lock competitive — the surprise of the cycle. Anything under R+5 is a wave marker.

races.label: Ohio — U.S. Senate (special)
races.region: Statewide (remainder of JD Vance's term)
races.seat_status: Held by appointed Republican Jon Husted
races.rating: Lean R / Toss-up — polls within the margin
races.baseline: Trump +11 (2024); Brown lost to Moreno by 3.6 in 2024
races.watch_for: Sherrod Brown's comeback. Early-reporting state: a Brown lead at 9 PM CT is a big tell.

races.label: Georgia — U.S. Senate
races.region: Statewide (runoff Dec. 1 if no majority)
races.baseline: Trump +2 (2024); Ossoff won 2021 runoff by 1.2
races.watch_for: The Democrats' most exposed incumbent; a comfortable Ossoff win means the GOP map isn't expanding.

races.label: Iowa — U.S. Senate
races.region: Statewide (open seat)
races.watch_for: Turek vs. Hinson is the GOP's canary: losing Iowa means the Senate is in play.

races.label: Wisconsin — Governor
races.region: Statewide (open seat)
races.watch_for: Pure 50/50 state; Milwaukee County Exec Crowley vs. Rep. Tiffany. No official state results feed — manual entry.

races.label: Ohio — Governor
races.region: Statewide (open seat)
races.watch_for: Ramaswamy's negatives vs. Acton's COVID-era profile; pairs with the Senate special as Ohio's double tell.

races.label: New York — Governor
races.region: Statewide
races.baseline: Hochul 53–47 over Zeldin (2022); Harris +13 (2024)
races.watch_for: Margin check: Hochul under +8 would echo 2022's GOP suburban surge and hurt downballot House Democrats.

races.label: Florida — Governor
races.region: Statewide (open seat)
races.baseline: DeSantis +19 (2022); Trump +13 (2024)
races.watch_for: Jolly (ex-GOP congressman) within single digits of Donalds in a R+13 state is itself the story.

fl.name: Florida Division of Elections — Florida Election Watch
fl.notes: Unofficial election-night returns reported by county Supervisors of Elections. Contest pages at /ContestResultsByCounty/{id}; the probe discovers contest ids by name.

mi.name: Michigan Secretary of State — Election Night Reporting
mi.notes: Statewide unofficial results compiled from county clerks. State now points to the MVIC vote-history site for Nov 2026; mielections.us kept as fallback.

va.name: Virginia Department of Elections — Election Night Reporting (Enhanced Voting)
va.notes: Official unofficial-results feed with a public JSON API; the probe records the API routes used by the single-page app.

tx.name: Texas Secretary of State — Election Night Returns
tx.notes: Free public portal refreshed every ~5 minutes; counties report early vote first, then Election Day. SOS also sells a $250 XML newsfeed (not used).

mt.name: Montana Secretary of State — Election Night Reporting
mt.notes: Counties must post to this site before releasing results elsewhere (HB 196, 2023). Polls close 8 PM MT / 10 PM ET.

nc.name: North Carolina State Board of Elections — Election Night Results
nc.notes: Precinct-level TSV snapshot re-uploaded every ~5 minutes: s3.amazonaws.com/dl.ncsbe.gov/ENRS/2026_11_03/results_pct_20261103.zip. Polls close 7:30 PM ET.

manual.name: Manual entry (no official statewide live feed)
manual.notes: Maine and Wisconsin do not run a statewide election-night results site; enter AP numbers via manual_overrides.json.

mn.name: Minnesota Secretary of State — Election Results
mn.notes: Public results site with media text files.
